correctness.rationale: Fresh arithmetic generation reproduces the exact bases n=1..10, and the eight realized augmented pairs are closed under substitution and contain the seed. Their third iterates cover every length-eight window, with 24 even and 32 odd words and no shared word. A collision of length n>=8 must have equal start parities. Even starts project to equal length-ceil(n/2) half-index factors. For odd starts, the even comparison at offset 1 and odd comparison at offset 2 force equal parity of the half-indices; then all comparisons give a contiguous equal block of length floor(n/2)+1 at the half-indices. Thus j<2R(ceil(n/2)) is impossible. Conversely, the earlier match at the origin doubles by the bit recurrence since the base repetition position is even, and this persists through induction for n>=11. At a first collision uniqueness follows because two earlier matches would already collide. The closed form follows by halving, and powers of two and lengths one greater give the two ratio extrema.
residual_risks: The replay establishes the finite bases and synchronization certificate only; the proof checks supply the unrestricted induction.
